text.body: sahastraśīrṣaṃ devaṃ viśvākṣaṃ viśvaśaṃbhuvam | viśvaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam ||1|| viśvataḥ paramānnityaṃ viśvaṃ nārāyaṇan harim | viśvamevedaṃ puruṣastavdiśvamupajīvati ||2|| patiṃ viśvasyā''tmeśvara śāśvata śivamacyutam | nārāyaṇaṃ mahājñeyaṃ viśvātmānaṃ parāyaṇam ||3|| nārāyaṇaparojyotirātmānārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | nārāyaṇaparaṃ bramhatattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ | nārāyaṇa paro dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ||4|| yaccakiṃcijjagatsarvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate'pivā | antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ ||5|| anantamavyayaṃkavi samudrentaṃ viśvaśaṃbhuvam | padmakośapratīkāśa hadayaṃcāpyadhomukham ||6|| adhoniṣṭhyāvitastyānte nābhyāmupari tiṣṭhati | jvālamālākulaṃbhāti viśvasyā''yatanaṃmahat ||7|| saṃtata śilābhistu lambatyākośasannibham | tasyānte suṣira sūkṣmaṃ tasminsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||8|| tasyamadhye mahānagnirviśvārcirviśvatomukhaḥ | so'grabhugvibhajantiṣṭhannāhāramajaraḥ kaviḥ | tiryagūrdhvamadhaḥśāyī raśmayastasyasaṃtatā ||9|| saṃtāpayati svaṃdehamāpādatalamastakaḥ | tasyamadhye vahniśikhā aṇīyordhvā vyavasthitaḥ ||10|| nīlatoyadamadhyasthāvdidyullekhevabhāsvarā | nīvāraśūkavattanvī pītā bhāsvatyaṇūpamā ||11|| tasyāḥ śikhāyāmadhye paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ | sabramha saśivaḥ sahariḥ sendraḥ sokṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ ||12||
